The '''S-X Vac-u-Bot''' was a sort of [[Labor droid/Legends|Labor Droid]] used in hangars and [[Hangar/Legends|Docking Bays]].

==Specifications==
The [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] S-X Vac-u-Bot was a big [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with wheels used to extract excess fuel and coolant from [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. They were also suitable for keeping cabling and piping tidy so that fuel and energy could be carried through smoothly. Sometimes it happened that [[Scrubber droid/Legends|Scrubber droids]] and the S-X came into conflict when they walked each other to a new task.

In the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], such S-X units were set up.
